padding-inline.$description: Space between the page’s content and its edges, on both sides, set by Shell on Main and the Footer. Containers and other components have no side margins of their own.

padding-top-focused.$description: Space above Main in Shell’s focused mode, so the page’s title clears the floating BackLink: the link’s inset (spacing/md) plus its height (control/size/md), rounded to the spacing scale.

padding-top.$description: Space above Main on default pages, set by Shell, so the page’s first block has room at the top. Points to main/spacing/section-gap, so the top of the page and the space between its blocks match. Focused mode uses main/padding-top-focused instead.

sm.$description: Height of controls (buttons, inputs, selects). Square controls like IconButton also use it for width. Stays at 44px or more on Medium and Small for touch.

md.$description: Height of controls (buttons, inputs, selects). Square controls like IconButton also use it for width. Stays at 44px or more on Medium and Small for touch.

lg.$description: Height of controls (buttons, inputs, selects). Square controls like IconButton also use it for width. Stays at 44px or more on Medium and Small for touch.

xl.$description: Height of controls (buttons, inputs, selects). Square controls like IconButton also use it for width. Stays at 44px or more on Medium and Small for touch.

sm.$description: Left and right padding inside controls, so text lines up across buttons and inputs of the same size.

gap.$description: Space between an icon and the label inside a control.
